title: Ausbildung zum*r Fachinformatiker*in Systemintegration 2027
description: Du hast Spaß daran, anderen das Arbeiten mit IT leicht zu machen – und willst verstehen, was im Hintergrund passiert, wenn Laptop, Account, Software und Rechte sauber zusammenspielen? Du möchtest lernen, wie wir unsere Kolleg*innen im Alltag unterstützen: von „Mein Setup funktioniert nicht“ über „Welche Software brauche ich?“ bis hin zu Onboarding, Geräteausgabe und Zugriffsrechten? Bei uns lernst Du, wie professionelle Office-IT arbeitet: strukturiert, serviceorientiert und mit modernen Tools – damit alle Teams optimal arbeiten können. Im Rahmen der Ausbildung zum/zur Fachinformatiker*in Systemintegration baust Du Dir das Fundament für Deine Zukunft in der Office-IT / IT-Support / Workplace-Administration auf. Du lernst, Arbeitsplätze zu planen und bereitzustellen, Hardware zu konfigurieren und zu betreuen, Software zu paketieren/auszurollen und Lizenzen zu verwalten. Außerdem bekommst Du Einblicke in User- und Access-Management, IT-Sicherheit im Arbeitsalltag, Standardisierung, Dokumentation sowie in den Umgang mit Ticketsystemen und Support-Prozessen (1st & 2nd Level). Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kolleg*innen zuverlässig, sicher und effizient arbeiten können. Dein Blick über den Tellerrand - System Administration: Ein fester Teil Deiner Ausbildung findet in unserer System Administration statt. Dort lernst Du die Technik kennen, die hinter unseren Spielen läuft: Wie tausende Linux-Server automatisiert verwaltet werden, wie Netzwerke, Monitoring und Backups aufgebaut sind und wie man mit Skripting wiederkehrende Aufgaben abschafft. Du siehst also nicht nur den Arbeitsplatz Deiner Kolleg*innen, sondern auch die Infrastruktur dahinter – und verstehst am Ende, wie beides zusammenhängt. Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Bewirb Dich jetzt für den Ausbildungsbeginn im August 2027 . Dich erwartet aktive Unterstützung durch ein engagiertes Team, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen und ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit und Servicegedanke wirklich zählen.  Dein Skillset Klasse Leistung.  Du wirst Dein Abitur oder Deine Fachhochschulreife mit guten Noten absolvieren – besonders in NAT, Englisch und idealerweise auch Informatik. Erste Praxis. Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit einem Mac oder auch mit dem Aufsetzen eines Netzwerks bringst Du bereits mit. Zukunftsgestalter*in. Du siehst in der Künstlichen Intelligenz die Chance, die Zukunft unserer Spiele mitzugestalten und freust dich, Deine Begeisterung und ersten KI-Erfahrungen in realen Projekten anzuwenden. Deutschkenntnisse. Für eine erfolgreiche Teilnahme an unserem Ausbildungsprogramm verfügst Du über ein B2/C1-Niveau in Deutsch, da der Berufsschulunterricht ausschließlich in deutscher Sprache stattfindet. Hands-on. Du packst gern an, probierst aus und bleibst dran, bis es läuft. Eigeninitiative . Du hast kein Problem auf Leute zuzugehen und Freude daran das technische Problem hinter der menschlichen Beschreibung zu erkennen. Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. Du freust Dich darauf, Deine sehr guten Englischkenntnisse täglich in Wort und Schrift anzuwenden. Deine Power-Ups Ein Team  von Spezialist*innen. Werde Teil eines großartigen, internationalen Teams von Spezialist*innen und arbeite und lerne bei einem der führenden Spieleentwickler und Publisher in Deutschland. Optimales Lernumfeld. Wir bieten dir ein äußerst interessantes technisches Umfeld und modernste Arbeitsbedingungen. Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung. Finanzielle Unabhängigkeit ermöglichen wir Dir mit unserer überdurchschnittlichen Ausbildungsvergütung: 1.270 EUR brutto im 1. Lehrjahr, 1.500 EUR brutto im 2. Lehrjahr, 1.715 EUR brutto im 3. Lehrjahr. Weiterentwicklung. Wir fördern Deine fachliche aber auch persönliche Weiterentwicklung mit einer optimalen Betreuung durch eine Ansprechperson aus der Fachabteilung sowie aus der Personalabteilung. Kostenübernahme. Wir unterstützen Dich bei der Aus- und Weiterbildung, auch über die normalen Ausbildungsinhalte hinaus, wir übernehmen die Kosten für Deine Fach- und Schulbücher und wir beteiligen uns an Deinem DeutschlandTicket. Herausragende Ausstattung. Du arbeitest mit einem MacBook Pro in herausragender Ausstattung und wir stellen Dir zusätzlich ein Smartphone oder Tablet Deiner Wahl zur Verfügung. Teamwork ist uns wichtig: Wir legen viel Wert auf ein Arbeitsklima, in dem Kommunikation und Interkulturalität großgeschrieben werden; wir feiern unsere Erfolge in regelmäßigen Afterworks sowie Team- und Unternehmensevents wie die InnoConf und der Social Day. Modernes und gemütliches Büro. Wir bieten Dir diverse Möglichkeiten Arbeit und Wohlbefinden miteinander zu vereinbaren: frisches Obst und kostenlose Getränke, hauseigenes Fitnessstudio, Gaming-Bereich, Dachterrasse mit BBQ, Relaxing-Rooms und vieles mehr. InnoGames ist einer der führenden deutschen Entwickler und Publisher von Mobile- und Browsergames und ein zertifizierter Great Place to Work®. Das Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hamburg wurde 2007 gegründet und gehört heute zur Modern Times Group (MTG). Zusammen mit ca. 350 Mitarbeitern aus 40 Nationen entwickeln die Unternehmensgründer einzigartige Games, die Millionen von Spielern auf der ganzen Welt jahrelangen Spaß bieten. Bekannt ist InnoGames vor allem für Forge of Empires, Elvenar und Die Stämme, aber das Unternehmen vergrößert sein mittlerweile 10 Spiele umfassendes Portfolio kontinuierlich über Plattformen und Genres hinweg. Die letzten Neuzugänge waren Heroes of History, ein neuartiger Mix aus City Builder und Hero Collection RPG und Cozy Coast, ein Strandabenteuer zum Wohlfühlen mit ausgefeiltem Merge-2-Gameplay und einer packenden Story.    Du bist bereit Deine Reise mit InnoGames zu beginnen und Teil unseres Teams zu werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung inkl. Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen ausschließlich als Onlinebewerbung über  innogames.com/career . Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist  Saara Harris . title: Werkstudent Fahrzeugpflege & Aufbereitung – FINN Station München (m/w/d)
description: Your Role Du liebst Autos und siehst sofort, ob ein Fahrzeug wirklich top ist oder nur sauber aussieht? An unserer FINN Station in München sorgst du dafür, dass jedes Auto in perfektem Zustand bei unseren Kund:innen ankommt. Damit machst du den ersten Eindruck von FINN zu einem Erlebnis, das in Erinnerung bleibt. Your Mission Du übernimmst die Pflege und Aufbereitung unserer Fahrzeuge innen wie außen und bringst jedes Auto in einen übergabebereiten Top-Zustand. Du prüfst die Fahrzeuge vor jeder Übergabe auf technische Basics wie Reifen, Beleuchtung und Flüssigkeitsstände und meldest Auffälligkeiten direkt an das Team. Du dokumentierst den Fahrzeugzustand bei Aus- und Rückgabe sorgfältig mit Fotos und Checklisten und schaffst so eine faire, transparente Grundlage für alle Beteiligten. Du hältst die Station organisiert, rangierst Fahrzeuge und stellst sicher, dass jedes Auto pünktlich zur Übergabe bereitsteht. Du bringst dein Auto-Know-how ein, um unsere Pflegestandards und Abläufe an der Station kontinuierlich besser zu machen. Du unterstützt das Team bei Übergaben und bist für Kund:innen vor Ort ein:e kompetente:r Ansprechpartner:in rund ums Fahrzeug. Your Profile Must-have: Immatrikulierte:r Student:in an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule mit der Möglichkeit, während des Semesters 20 Std./Woche und in den Semesterferien bis zu 40 Std./Woche zu arbeiten. Echte Leidenschaft für Autos und ein geschultes Auge fürs Detail: Du merkst, wenn etwas nicht stimmt. Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B (PKW) und sicherer Umgang beim Rangieren von Fahrzeugen. Zuverlässige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, Freude an praktischer Arbeit sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2).   Nice-to-have: Erste Erfahrung in der Fahrzeugaufbereitung oder Autopflege, z. B. im Autohaus, in einer Waschanlage, im Detailing oder als ambitioniertes Hobby. Gute Englischkenntnisse und Freude am Kontakt mit Kund:innen. WHY FINN Attractive Compensation (Attraktives Gehalt): Deine Leistung wird belohnt. Bei uns erwartet dich eine attraktive Vergütung von 16,00 Euro pro Stunde für deinen Einsatz und dein Engagement im Team. Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport. Fast-Track Career Growth (Karriere & Weiterentwicklung): Lerne von den Besten. In unserem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld hast du die Möglichkeit, aktiv mitzugestalten, steil zu lernen und dich beruflich sowie persönlich rasant weiterzuentwickeln. Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam. About Us FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor. Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!   Weitere Informationen: www.finn.com Gleiche Chancen für Alle FINN steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen. Bereit für die Mobilität der Zukunft? Bewirb dich jetzt! title: Account Executive - Germany 🇩🇪
description: Our Mission ⚖️ At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform. Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard. Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities. Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting. And we're just getting started. Doctrine employs over 230 people and has been growing steadily and profitably for several years. In 2025, we are entering a new phase, becoming multi-country and multi-product. After launching in our first international market, Italy, Doctrine is continuing its global expansion with Germany. We are therefore looking to several Account Executive in Germany to scale our commercial impact in the German market.   A word about the Germany Team ✨ When you join, you’ll be onboarded and supported by your manager, Pascale (Head of New Business), who will help you ramp up and succeed in your role. You’ll work closely with our first Account Executive on the German market, Danu , collaborating on opportunities and helping drive our growth in Germany. You’ll also be supported by our broader German go-to-market team 🇩🇪, enabling you to move forward confidently in your conversations with prospects: Audrey (Product Manager), Maïte (Legal Counsel), and Laura (Field Marketing Manager). Responsibilities Prospect and leverage inbound leads to build a strong pipeline of opportunities Understand the challenges of your prospects, and build relevant go-to-market strategies Run the full sales cycle, from outreach to demos, negotiations, and closing Share insights and learnings from the German market with the internal Germany squad Achieve monthly targets set by the company for your market Profile You are fluent in German You have experience in sales, especially SaaS sales You have a hunter mindset and aim to exceed your sales targets You have excellent written and verbal communication skills: you listen actively and communicate with empathy, clarity, and precision You are extremely rigorous and detail-oriented You have a strong sense of ownership and a taste for challenges: you thrive in demanding environments, are motivated by performance-based incentives, and appreciate an uncapped variable compensation Knowledge of the legal sector is a plus Travels within France may be required Why join Doctrine We are building the best product on the market with the largest tech team in Europe dedicated to AI applied to law – you’ll be proud to pitch Doctrine! We are ambitious, growing, and have been profitable for several years Doctrine employees are our greatest asset – and that’s not just a slogan: our customer satisfaction from day one has been driven by our team. We invest time, energy, and resources to hire the right people, onboard them effectively, and support their professional development What's in it for you ☀️ 🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team). 🌴 A flexible leave policy 🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities 🏄‍♂️ Regular team events 📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions 🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities 🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year 👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan 🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month) 💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform 🍏 Brand new Apple equipment Our values 🤝 At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward. You will use modern AI tools, including agentic coding workflows, thoughtfully to improve how you explore, build, test, and maintain software. You will also contribute actively to the team's Agile ways of working, understanding how planning, refinement, delivery, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement fit together.</p> <h2 title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3> <p>Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.</p> <p>As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London</li> <li>Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you</li> <li>Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering</li> <li>Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows</li> <li>Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework</li> <li>Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member</li> <li>Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap</li> <li>Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –&nbsp; Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).</li> <li>Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.&nbsp;</p> <div id="message-list_1777351501.983109"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote</span></div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Go-to-Market-Kennzahlen wie Pipeline Coverage und Win Rates untersuchst du. Gemeinsam mit dem C-Level erstellst du Board- und Leadership-Unterlagen. In der Post-Merger-Integration übernimmst du eine führende Rolle. KI: Täglich im Einsatz und immer einen Schritt weiter Mit KI baust du deine eigenen Tools: Analysen automatisieren, Dashboards und Workflows aufsetzen. Das bringst du mit Einen Master oder einen fortgeschrittenen Bachelor in BWL, MINT, VWL oder einem verwandten Fach. Verfügbarkeit für mindestens 3 Monate. Eine strukturierte, hypothesengetriebene Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Umsetzung. KI-Kompetenz: Du nutzt KI-Tools jeden Tag, steigerst damit deine Produktivität und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch. Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, und du erstellst visuell überzeugende Präsentationen für Management und Board, die direkt auf den Punkt kommen. Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Wir ermutigen dich ausdrücklich, sie intensiv für Content, Design, Analyse und Reporting zu nutzen. Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind remote-first, deshalb kannst du flexibel von zu Hause arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil, immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Die genaue Aufteilung besprechen wir im Vorstellungsgespräch. Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub plus gesetzliche Feiertage. Work-Life-Balance: Du sollst an deinem Schreibtischstuhl keine Wurzeln schlagen. Du wählst zwischen einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und einer Givve-Karte. Ein Team, das du wirklich triffst: Die ganze Firma kommt zweimal im Jahr zusammen, dazu gibt es regelmäßige Team-Events und Culture Days. Arbeiten im Ausland: Nach der Probezeit kannst du auch aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten. Sprich uns im Gespräch gern auf Remote Work an. Flip AI ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt. title: Mission Operations Manager
description: Join SE3 Labs as Mission Operations Manager Run the field exercises that put SE3's autonomous systems in the hands of military units, and bring back the insight that shapes what we build next. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Mission Operations team , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. About the Role As Mission Operations Manager, you'll plan and run the exercises and trials that prove SE3's autonomous systems and Spatial AI in realistic conditions. You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for the operational units we work with, partnering closely with our engineering, product and commercial teams and travelling regularly across Europe. What you capture in the field becomes the evidence and requirements that move our product and programmes forward. What You'll Work On Exercise Planning: Plan trials and exercises within our exercise programme, from component tests through to multi-system exercises, with clear scenarios, objectives and success criteria. Exercise Delivery: Run exercises on the ground, coordinating the people, systems and logistics involved so that each one delivers usable results. User Liaison: Act as the day-to-day contact for operational units. Build trusted working relationships and keep a steady flow of feedback between users and SE3. Operational Assessment: Assess how our systems perform in realistic conditions and document their operational value, limitations and integration needs in clear post-exercise reports. Requirements Capture: Translate user feedback and field observations into structured requirements that product and engineering can prioritise and act on. Programme Support: Supply the commercial team with operational evidence, demonstrations and field insight that help turn engagement into awarded programmes. Team Building: Help establish the processes, templates and ways of working that let the Mission Operations team scale as SE3 grows. Your Profile You take ownership of outcomes and get things done without waiting for direction. You turn plans into well-run activities and hold yourself to a consistently high standard. You bring several years of experience in military operations, trials or capability development, ideally as a serving or former officer or NCO, or in a field or trials role with a defence supplier. You have a solid technical understanding of unmanned systems, autonomy or software-defined defence, and engage credibly with both engineers and operators. You're highly organised and comfortable running complex activities with many moving parts, often outdoors and under time pressure. You communicate clearly and build trust quickly with military users, partners and internal teams. You're willing to travel regularly across Europe and into other markets where SE3 operates. You speak native-level German and have full professional fluency in English, written and spoken. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and hold the security clearance required for this role. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Experience planning or running military exercises, trials or experimentation campaigns involving unmanned or autonomous systems. Hands-on experience operating drones, with EU UAS operator certificates a plus. Experience in NATO or other multinational exercise environments. Familiarity with defence procurement and how operational trials lead to funded programmes. Exercise Planning Case: We share a realistic scenario and ask you to outline how you would plan and run a trial around it. Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Visual Localization

Build and lead the team that makes our autonomous systems know where they are.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our localization technology, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

You will hire and develop engineers, own the localization roadmap, set priorities and deliver a system that works on real sensors, within onboard compute limits and in difficult field conditions.

You will remain closely involved in architecture, core algorithms and debugging, with roughly 20–40% of your time spent coding. Work with senior individual contributors to set technical direction and with robotics software, embedded, hardware and field teams to turn it into a reliable deployed system.

What You’ll Work On

  • Build the Team: Hire excellent localization engineers, assess their technical work and help them develop. Give clear feedback, establish ownership and build a team that can solve difficult problems together.

  • Roadmap and Delivery: Own the roadmap and delivery of VIO, SLAM, sensor fusion, calibration, mapping and relocalization. Turn mission requirements and observed failures into specific engineering priorities.

  • Technical Direction: Guide architecture and core algorithm decisions with the team. Make the tradeoffs between accuracy, robustness, latency, memory and power explicit and test them against real data.

  • Evaluation and Replay: Build the evaluation and replay loop so the team can make most improvements from recorded data. Set measurable criteria for accuracy, robustness and runtime, and maintain regression tests that catch failures before deployment.

  • Hands-On Engineering: Stay involved in critical algorithms, production code and difficult debugging. Help resolve failures caused by timing, calibration, vibration, motion blur, poor lighting and degraded sensors.

  • Integration: Coordinate sensor and compute requirements, interfaces and integration with adjacent teams. Ensure localization outputs and uncertainty estimates work for planning, control and downstream autonomy.

  • Field Deployment: Take the system through live sensor testing and field deployment. Use mission logs and observed failures to decide what the team builds next.

Your Profile

  • You have personally built VIO or SLAM systems and taken substantial parts through deployment. You can explain your implementation, its limitations and measured improvements in accuracy, robustness or runtime.

  • You have led engineers through difficult technical work. You can point to systems your team delivered, people you helped develop and the decisions you were responsible for. This may be your first formal management role if you can demonstrate that experience.

  • You can assess an engineer’s technical work, give useful feedback and help them improve. You take an active role in recruiting and selecting the people who join your team.

  • You have strong foundations in 3D geometry, estimation, optimization and sensor fusion, and enough depth to examine algorithm and architecture decisions in detail.

  • You write production C++ and use Python for analysis, evaluation and tooling. You are comfortable working with Linux, real sensors, calibration, synchronization and constrained onboard compute. Rust experience is a plus.

  • You have used replay, evaluation datasets and automated tests to guide development. You can explain how your team measured progress, reproduced failures and decided when a system was ready to deploy.

  • You have a master’s degree, PhD or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technical field.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience deploying perception systems on Nvidia Jetson, embedded CPUs/GPUs, writing CUDA kernels, optimizing deep neural networks for edge deployment.

  • Experience with LWIR thermal cameras (for navigation), rolling shutter effects, visual-inertial calibration, multi-camera rigs, fisheye/wide-angle lenses or monocular depth.

  • Experience with GNSS-denied navigation in UAV context, terrain-relative navigation, map-based localization and re-localization.

  • Experience building evaluation datasets, replay systems, perception observability, log tooling, and automated regression pipelines.

  • Publications or open-source contributions in SLAM, VIO, 3D computer vision, state estimation, or robotics are welcome, but not required.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Conversation (45 Mins): High level discussion about your technical experience and what we are working on

  3. Coding / Algorithm Interview: We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  4. Technical Interview (90 mins): We dive into your experience with perception, state estimation, SLAM/VIO, robotics, and real-world debugging

  5. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a good fit on both sides

(Remote)

Territories: France / Benelux / Southern Europe 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe. 

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

  

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

Belmont Lavan sucht einen Senior SAP Consultant (m/w/d), der Kunden bei der Planung, Einführung und Optimierung von SAP-Lösungen begleitet. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf S/4HANA-Transformationsprojekten – von der Analyse über das Design bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus.

Sie verantworten fachliche Workstreams, beraten Fachbereiche auf Augenhöhe und geben Ihr Wissen an jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter.

Requirements

  • Sie leiten Workshops mit Fachbereichen, analysieren Geschäftsprozesse und erarbeiten SAP-Soll-Konzepte
  • Sie erstellen Fachkonzepte und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzen diese im Customizing um
  • Sie verantworten Workstreams in S/4HANA-Einführungs- und Migrationsprojekten (Greenfield, Brownfield, Selective Data Transition)
  • Sie stimmen Schnittstellen und Integrationen mit anderen SAP-Modulen und Drittsystemen ab
  • Sie planen und steuern Testphasen (Unit-, Integrations- und Abnahmetests) und begleiten den Go-live
  • Sie schulen Key-User und erstellen die zugehörige Dokumentation
  • Sie coachen Junior-Berater und sichern die Qualität der Projektergebnisse
  • Sie unterstützen bei Angeboten, Aufwandsschätzungen und Pre-Sales-Terminen

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP-Beratung, davon mindestens 2 vollständige Implementierungsprojekte
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA und tiefes Know-how in mindestens einem Modul (z. B. FI/CO, SD, MM)
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis der zugehörigen Geschäftsprozesse und der modulübergreifenden Integration
  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Workshops und der Steuerung von Projektteams
  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und souveränes Auftreten beim Kunden
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundeneinsätze

Von Vorteil

  • SAP-Zertifizierung in S/4HANA (z. B. Financial Accounting oder Sales)
  • Erfahrung mit SAP Activate und RISE with SAP

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen Hiring Manager Interview Deep-dive technical interviews Final interview : mission & values alignment We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

Our Fleet Operations Team ensures that our vehicles and staff continuously meet the highest standards in safety, performance, and regulatory compliance. Working collaboratively across various functions, the team plays a key role in developing and delivering training, maintaining operating standards, and supporting the professional growth of our people within a fast-paced and innovative environment.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, making recommendations for improvements.

  • Maintain up-to-date training records and ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

  • Conduct regular assessments of operating standards across teams and individuals to uphold our quality objectives.

  • Develop and maintain training materials, including manuals, presentations, and online resources.

  • Work closely with subject matter experts to identify areas for improvement in training content, delivery, and operating standards.

  • Monitor and analyse training metrics to identify trends and suggest opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and oversee implementation of quality assurance processes for both training programs and operating standards.

  • Support staff professional development and course completion, in conjunction with Team Leads.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand and anticipate training needs related to the growth of commercial operations.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Building, evaluating, and improving training programs for fleet operations.

  • Upholding and enhancing the effectiveness and compliance of all operating standards across teams.

  • Creating and updating a library of high-quality training materials.

  • Implementing and tracking quality assurance processes for all training and operational exercises.

  • Supporting the development and progression of Wayve’s staff through tailored training and development initiatives.

  • Analysing data to ensure continuous improvement of both training content and delivery methods.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You hold a full clean DE driving licence and have at least 8 years' driving experience (mainly in DE).

  • You have no blameworthy insurance claims within the past three years.

  • You remain calm and controlled in pressured situations.

  • You’re receptive to feedback, eager to learn from mistakes, and have a growth mindset.

  • You enjoy working closely with people in a team environment.

  • You can manage your wellbeing (including fatigue/stress) and have proven personal strategies for doing so.

  • You have proven experience as a team coordinator or in a similar role.

  • You demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills—both one-to-one, within your team, and when engaging other stakeholders.

  • You can work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • You have excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, time management, and organisational ability.

  • You are proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office suite.

  • You have excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 

Desirable:

  • Recognised Assessor qualification.

  • Qualified Vehicle Safety Operator with a current qualification.

  • Recognised Quality Assurance qualification.

 

Additional Requirements:

  • Available to work full-time onsite (Leonberg office), 5 days a week.

  • Must disclose any second job as part of the application process.

  • All applicants will be subject to a health check before/after employment.

  • Employment is contingent upon passing training, pre-employment checks, and ongoing drug/alcohol testing in line with company policy. Testing will occur during your onsite interview.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

description: About Us We are building Physics AI for hardware design . Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value. As trusted technical advisors , you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics , you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel , primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team . Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion , providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected. Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering. Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren. Deine Aufgaben: Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung der KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur als Enterprise-KI-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure Technische Leitung von ML-Pipeline-Projekten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Training, Deployment, Monitoring und Drift Detection Konzeption und Optimierung von RAG-Architekturen, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Chunking, Retrieval, Guardrails und Context Orchestration Definition und Weiterentwicklung von MLOps-Strategien einschließlich CI/CD für Modelle, Experiment-Tracking und Model Registry Technische Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams aus ML/AI Engineers, LLM Engineers und MLOps Engineers Beratung interner und externer Stakeholder zu KI-Architekturen sowie Präsentation technischer Konzepte gegenüber IT-Leitung und Fachbereichen DAS IST UNS WICHTIG Fundierte Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten KI-/ML-Lösungen, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Azure Machine Learning und Azure OpenAI Service. Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken. Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex. Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse. Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights. Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen. Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert. title: Senior Product Designer - Berlin
description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it. The mandate We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform. This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers. Responsibilities Product design and leadership Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints. Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation. Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team. Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data. Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code. Design systems and AI Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code. Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently. Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully. Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use. Who we are looking for A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale. 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area. Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders. Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't. Deep experience building and maintaining design systems, including design tokens, component libraries and documentation, and keeping Figma and code in sync. An understanding of what makes a design system usable by AI: structured tokens, consistent naming, well-defined component properties and clear usage guidance. Expert UI and interaction design skills with a keen eye for detail. A strong grasp of user-centred design and balancing user and business needs. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and experience working in Agile product teams. Experience designing AI-powered or personalised product experiences is a plus. What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. Flexibility in working arrangements, offering hybrid or remote work options based on role requirements and location. Matching pension schemes and/or 401k. Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on RA merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. Regular company-wide Q&As with senior leadership, along with ongoing virtual educational training sessions for all staff. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ). More about RA We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis. Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE&nbsp;</u></span></strong></p> <p>The <strong>Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys</strong> owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.</p> <p>Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.</p> <p>You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.</li> <li>Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.</li> <li>Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.</li> <li>Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.</li> <li>Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.</li> <li>Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.</li> <li>Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2753" data-local-id="9ae6a13b-2175-4a37-a4c2-5839b2f592ae"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Qualifications</span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2769" data-local-id="46937c2f-d543-4fbd-b76c-3593c6541fb4"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Required: </span></strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).</li> <li>Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.</li> <li>Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.</li> <li>Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.</li> <li>SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.</li> <li>A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).</li> <li>Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.</li> <li>Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).</li> <li>Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3083" data-local-id="dbaae2d5-3e8d-43bb-be8c-e1c7e3b63382"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Preferred:&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="20322c78-4bdc-4d7a-af35-387a22f0e7ab" data-indent-level="1"> <li><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY &amp; HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.
