title: (Senior) Consultant* – Securities & Custody Operations
description: <div id="ScreenPanelContainer22Content" class="cc-content"> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Standort: Frankfurt / München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Capital Markets | Anstellungsart: Unbefristet</strong></p> <p><strong>Gestalte die Zukunft von Securities &amp; Custody Operations im Finanzdienstleistungssektor.</strong></p> <p><strong>Die Rolle</strong></p> <p>Als (Senior) Consultant* in unserer Capital Markets Practice arbeitest Du mit führenden Finanzinstituten zusammen, um deren Securities-, Custody- und Capital-Markets-Operations zu transformieren und zu optimieren.</p> <p>Du bringst fundierte Fachkenntnisse entlang des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und im Post-Trade-Umfeld mit. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden analysierst Du komplexe operative Herausforderungen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in praxisorientierte Lösungen. Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung und arbeitest dabei eng mit Stakeholdern aus Operations, Technologie und Change zusammen.</p> <p><strong>Was Du bei uns machst</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du unterstützt Transformationsinitiativen in den Bereichen Securities, Custody und Post-Trade Operations – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Implementierung.</li> <li>Du analysierst bestehende Operating Models, Prozesse und Kontrollen und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung, Optimierung und Effizienzsteigerung.</li> <li>Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern aus Business, Operations und Technologie zusammen, definierst Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in praxisorientierte Lösungen.</li> <li>Du setzt Dein Wissen über Wertpapierprozesse ein – einschließlich Trade Lifecycle, Settlement, Asset Servicing und Custody Operations – um komplexe Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu lösen.</li> <li>Du unterstützt die Projektdurchführung durch Workshops, Analysen, Dokumentation, Stakeholder Management und Implementierungsbegleitung.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Was wir von Dir erwarten</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevante Beratungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungserfahrung in den Bereichen Securities, Custody, Post-Trade oder Capital Markets Operations.</li> <li>Fundierte Kenntnisse des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und operativer Prozesse wie Settlement, Custody, Asset Servicing und/oder Corporate Actions.</li> <li>Erfahrung in Business Transformation, Prozessoptimierung, Operating Models oder Change-Initiativen innerhalb der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche.</li> <li>Ausgeprägte analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen in klare und praxisorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.</li> <li>Sichere Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Business- und Technologie-Teams.</li> <li>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Von Vorteil</strong></p> <ul> <li>Erfahrung bei oder mit Global Custodians, Investmentbanken, Asset Managern, Marktinfrastrukturen oder Securities-Services-Anbietern.</li> <li>Kenntnisse regulatorischer und branchenspezifischer Entwicklungen im Securities- und Post-Trade-Umfeld.</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Operating Model Design, Prozessoptimierung oder umfangreichen Transformationsprogrammen.</li> <li>Kenntnisse von Wertpapierplattformen, Custody-Systemen oder Post-Trade-Technologien.</li> <li>Beratungserfahrung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen in komplexen Finanzdienstleistungsorganisationen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Warum Capco?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Arbeite an wirkungsvollen Lösungen für führende Finanzinstitute.</li> <li>Erlebe eine kollaborative, flache und unternehmerisch geprägte Beratungskultur.</li> <li>Nutze kontinuierliche Lernangebote, Trainings und Branchenzertifizierungen.</li> <li>Werde Teil eines Teams, das die Zukunft der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche mitgestaltet.</li> <li>Gestalte die Transformation im Capital-Markets-Umfeld aktiv mit.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Wir bieten Dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Benefits-Paket, das Deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt:</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich</li> <li>Ein umfassendes Onboarding und Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy</li> <li>Bike Leasing Programme</li> <li>Capco Benefits Card mit monatlicher Gutschrift i.H.v. 44 EUR</li> <li>Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks sowie Mental Health Kurse</li> <li>Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung für alle Lebenslagen</li> <li>Kontinuierliches Feedback und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. über interne Trainings und Udemy Business)</li> <li>Großartige Firmenevents &amp; After Work Veranstaltungen</li> <li>Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag</li> <li>Autonomie, flache Hierarchien, Hands-on-Mentalität und schnelle Entscheidungswege</li> <li>Ein dynamisches, wachstumsstarkes und internationales Umfeld mit zahlreichen Möglichkeiten Dich und Deine Talente einzubringen</li> </ul> <p><strong>Inklusion bei Capco</strong></p> <p>Wir setzen uns dafür ein, unseren Recruiting-Prozess für alle zugänglich und unkompliziert zu gestalten. Wenn Du in irgendeiner Phase Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigst, lass es uns einfach wissen – wir helfen Dir gerne weiter.</p> <p>Wir schätzen die individuellen Perspektiven und Beiträge jedes Einzelnen. Bei Capco glauben wir, dass Du am stärksten bist, wenn Du Du selbst sein kannst. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität und Zusammenarbeit – eine Haltung, die jeden Tag prägt, wie wir mit unseren Kunden und miteinander arbeiten.</p> <p>*(m/w/d) - Wichtig ist nur, dass wir zueinander passen! #BeYouselfAtWork</p> </div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

• Du möchtest moderne Plattformen gestalten und hast Spaß an Beratung, Automatisierung und Cloud-Technologien? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Einführung, dem Design und der Weiterentwicklung von Kubernetes-basierten Plattformen.
  • Du gestaltest, installierst und betreibst Kubernetes-Cluster – von Cluster-Design über Netzwerk (z. B. Cilium) und Storage (z. B. Ceph/Rook) bis zu Sicherheitskonzepten.
  • Du baust CI/CD-Pipelines inklusive Image-Builds und Registries auf und optimierst sie, z. B. mit GitLab CI/CD
  • Du automatisierst Infrastruktur-Bereitstellungen nach dem Prinzip Infrastructure as Code, z. B. mit Terraform.
  • Du implementierst moderne Observability-Lösungen für Logging, Monitoring und Tracing.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Kubernetes- und DevOps-Umgebungen, behebst Fehler und optimierst die Plattformen nachhaltig.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-Bereich beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Kubernetes-Clustern im On-Premise-Umfeld – z.B. RKE2
  • Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse in Container-Technologien (z. B. Docker, containerd oder Podman), Container-Registries (z. B. Harbor) sowie Netzwerk-Konzepten im Container-Kontext.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit CI/CD- und GitOps-Tools wie z.B. ArgoCD.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Infrastructure as Code und Konfigurationsmanagement, z. B. mit Ansible, Terraform oder OpenTofu, und kennst Dich mit YAML aus.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Observability, Plattform-Security und dem Betrieb zustandsbehafteter Dienste wie Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL mit CloudNativePG) auf Kubernetes.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, lösungsorientiert und legst großen Wert auf eine hohe Kundenorientierung. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend und bist bereit, Workshops und Trainings durchzuführen.

Werde Teil unseres Teams! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Über uns

Die proetzl unternehmensberatung ist eine Executive Search Boutique mit Sitz in der Münchner Maximilianstraße. Seit 1993 besetzen wir Führungs, Management und C Level Positionen für exklusive Mandanten im deutschen Mittelstand und im Konzernumfeld.

Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit Exklusivmandaten und diskreter Direktansprache. Über 1.400 erfolgreich abgeschlossene Searches sprechen für sich. Hinter dem Haus steht ein spezialisiertes, eingespieltes Team, in dem jede Rolle sichtbar ist und echten Impact hat.

Für den weiteren Ausbau unserer Research und AI Kapazitäten suchen wir dich.

Deine Rolle

Du bist unser verlängerter Arm im Research und baust parallel unsere AI gestützten Prozesse mit auf. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Managing Partner und unserem Team zusammen und bekommst von Tag eins Einblick in reale Executive Searches, nicht in Powerpoint Projekte.

Konkret heißt das: Du recherchierst Zielunternehmen, baust Longlists auf LinkedIn Recruiter und Sales Navigator, qualifizierst Profile vor und pflegst sie in unser internes CRM ein. Parallel bringst du moderne AI Tools in unseren Alltag, zum Beispiel für Profil Screening, Zusammenfassungen, Vorab-Checks von K.o. Kriterien oder automatisierte Datenanreicherung.

Wenn du Lust hast, auch mal selbst zum Hörer zu greifen und an Gatekeepern vorbei zum Entscheider durchzukommen, ist das ein großes Plus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Research und Longlist Aufbau für laufende Executive Search Mandate über LinkedIn Recruiter, Sales Navigator, XING TalentManager und weitere Tools

  • Boolean Suchen entwickeln, iterieren und dokumentieren

  • Profile vorqualifizieren, Dubletten checken, Statuspflege im internen CRM

  • Mitwirkung beim Aufbau und Testen von AI Workflows (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, eigene Agents) für Research, Profilanalyse und Dokumentenerstellung

  • Markt und Wettbewerbsanalysen für Mandate aus Industrie, Healthcare und Mittelstand

  • Vorbereitung von Datenblättern, Kandidatenprofilen und Unterlagen für Mandanten

  • Unterstützung bei der Pflege unseres Kandidatennetzwerks

  • Optional: Terminkoordination und erste Telefonate mit Kandidaten

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Eingeschriebenes Studium in Wirtschaft, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Kommunikation, Informatik, Data oder einem vergleichbaren Fach, idealerweise noch mindestens 12 Monate bis zum Abschluss

  • Erste Erfahrung im Recruiting, Executive Search, Research, Vertrieb oder in einer Beratung ist ein klares Plus, zwingend ist sie nicht

  • Hohe Affinität zu AI Tools und ehrliche Neugier darauf, Arbeitsprozesse mit KI besser zu machen

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, du brauchst keine Mikroführung

  • Spaß am Umgang mit Menschen und ein Auftreten, mit dem du auch am Telefon überzeugst

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift

Was wir bieten

  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins, keine Copy Paste Aufgaben

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Managing Partner und direktes Lernen am Executive Search Handwerk

  • Freie Hand, moderne AI Tools in den Arbeitsalltag zu bringen und eigene Workflows zu bauen

  • Volle Flexibilität beim Arbeitsort: unser Büro in bester Lage an der Maximilianstraße in München steht dir offen, genauso wie nahezu vollständiges Remote Arbeiten von überall in Deutschland

  • Flexible Zeiten rund ums Studium, in den Prüfungsphasen reduzieren wir unkompliziert

  • Faire Werkstudenten Vergütung, nach oben offen bei Leistung

  • Kleines Team, flache Hierarchien, direkter Draht zu den Partnern

  • Perspektive auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit über das Studium hinaus, auch als Junior Consultant

So läuft der Prozess

  • Du schickst uns deinen Lebenslauf oder deinen LinkedIn Link, kein klassisches Anschreiben nötig

  • Kurzes Kennenlernen per Telefon oder Teams (ca. 20 Minuten)

  • Persönliches Gespräch bei uns im Büro oder per Video

  • Entscheidung innerhalb von einer Woche

Kontakt

Herbert Prötzl | Inhaber proetzl unternehmensberatung | executive search I Maximilianstraße 35a, 80539 München I -----

title: Security Consultant (m/w/d)
description: DEINE AUFGABEN Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ein Security-Service-Produkt in unserem Security-Team – von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung beim Kunden. Du arbeitest für unsere Kunden an innovativen Themen und übernimmst Verantwortung in den Bereichen KI-Security und Informationssicherheit. Du implementierst und betreibst IT-Security-Tools wie zum Beispiel Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Agent 365. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau, bei der Weiterentwicklung und bei der Umsetzung von Information-Security-Frameworks wie ISO/IEC 27001. Du arbeitest flexibel und eigenverantwortlich für unsere Kunden – überwiegend remote, aber bei Bedarf auch vor Ort. DEIN PROFIL Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder über eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker: in. Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Bereich IT-Security und/oder Informationssicherheit mit. Du verfügst über Zertifizierungen im IT-Security-Umfeld und hast dich in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Themen spezialisiert: KI-Security, Microsoft Cloud Security, Informationssicherheit nach ISO/IEC 27001 oder BSI-Grundschutz. Analytisches Denkvermögen, Kreativität, Lösungsorientierung, Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke zeichnen dich aus. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen rund um IT-Security und Cloud-Technologien ein. Du hast Freude daran, beim Kunden Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mit deinen Ideen sowie deiner Persönlichkeit zu überzeugen. WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Dein Team hilft Dir sich in die verschiedenen IT-Security Themen einzuarbeiten und investiert Zeit, damit Du schnell Erfolge erzielen kannst. Deine Kollegen mit langjähriger Erfahrung im IT-Security und Projektgeschäft, helfen Dir bei Deinen ersten Aufgaben und unterstützen Dich von Anfang an. Mentoring : Ein Kollege wird Dich zusätzlich individuell als Mentor unterstützen und auch abseits des Einarbeitungsplan für alle Fragen da sein. Werde Teil unseres Teams! Role Objectives:
The IT Intern – AI & Transformation will support the Information Technology function by partnering with cross-functional departments to identify opportunities where AI and automation can streamline work, improve data-driven decision-making, and enable digital transformation. This role provides hands-on experience in AI-enabled tools, process and workflow automation, Python scripting, data analysis, and system optimization, within a responsible-AI framework and a GxP-regulated environment.  

The Ideal Candidate:
  • Curious and eager to learn
  • Able to take initiative and contribute ideas
  • Professional, reliable, and accountable
  • Team player who collaborates well with others
  • Adaptable and open to feedback

    • What You'll Do:
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand workflows, pain points and manual processes, and identify high-value opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Gather and document business and technical requirements, use cases and success measures for automation and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Design, build and maintain workflow automations using Python and low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps) to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
  • Evaluate, prototype, test and help implement AI-enabled tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI assistants and machine learning services), under appropriate supervision and in accordance with company policies.
  • Develop prompts, agents and AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity, and document guidance and best practices for their use.
  • Apply responsible-AI principles, including data privacy, security, accuracy validation and human oversight, and support compliance with company policy and GxP/regulatory expectations.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries and data pipelines to extract, transform and prepare data from multiple sources for analytics, automation and AI use cases.
  • Support data analysis initiatives by identifying trends, insights and opportunities for process improvement and measurable efficiency gains, and present automation impact and insights to technical and non-technical audiences through dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or Power BI (or similar tools).
  • Support system integrations, API-based connections and enhancements under the guidance of senior IT or data team members.
  • Track and report benefits of automation and AI initiatives (e.g., time saved, error reduction, adoption), and contribute to the transformation roadmap.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation, including process maps, technical notes, testing evidence and user guidance, and support change management and user training.
  • Participate in project meetings, provide status updates and contribute ideas to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives.

    • What You'll Need:
    Qualifications
     
  • Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into automation and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated interest and curiosity in AI, automation and emerging technologies, a willingness to keep learning, and awareness of responsible and ethical AI use, including data privacy, security and the limitations of AI outputs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks at once, work independently and contribute effectively as part of a collaborative team.
    •  
    Technical Skills and Strengths
     
  • Experience with Python for scripting, automation and data analysis, and working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Understanding of data fundamentals, including data cleaning, transformation and reporting, and familiarity with Tableau, Power BI or other data visualization and business intelligence tools.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools, prompt engineering and AI assistants such as Microsoft Copilot, along with exposure to AI and machine learning concepts, tools or frameworks.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation or low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps), and a basic understanding of systems, data flows and technology-enabled process improvement.
    •  
    Preferred (Desirable)
     
  • Experience with APIs, ETL processes, RPA or data integration tools, and exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-based AI services.
  • Understanding of AI governance, data protection or regulated (GxP) environments.
  • Prior internship, academic project or practical experience involving AI, automation, data or systems.

    Paid Internship
    Paid Time Off & Sick Time
    Medical Benefits
    Volunteer Day

With more than 15 years of global experience, we have supported programs across 150+ countries, combining operational scale with the agility and personalized service of a specialized provider. Our work helps bridge critical gaps in care, ensuring safe, ethical, and efficient access to promising new treatments.

scalability and cost efficiency across card issuing and processing.</li> <li>Embed AI-assisted and agentic development practices across engineering teams.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design and Commercial teams to prioritise and deliver the roadmap.</li> <li>Own technical relationships with card processors and schemes, including integrations and certifications.</li> <li>Strengthen engineering capabilities, particularly at Staff and senior IC levels.</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineering leaders across Payments on shared infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and a track record of leading large, distributed engineering organisations.</p> <p><strong>Experience and background</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering managers and large engineering teams.</li> <li>Strong experience in cards, payments or banking, with a deep understanding of card issuing, processing and card scheme operations. Experience on either the issuer or processor side is a strong plus.</li> <li>Experience building and operating distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.</li> <li>Proven ability to improve engineering delivery, productivity and quality.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product, Commercial and Finance leaders on business outcomes and unit economics.</li> <li>Experience managing third-party technology providers and strategic partnerships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native systems.</li> <li>Experience with relational databases, distributed systems and large-scale transaction processing.</li> <li>Ability to challenge architectural decisions and engage in technical and production-level discussions.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and their application across the software development lifecycle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to set technical direction and drive execution through engineering leaders.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.</li> <li>A strong focus on developing engineering talent and building high-performing teams.</li> </ul> <h3>OUR TECH STACK:&nbsp;</h3> <p>Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for asynchronous and event-driven messaging. Observability is Coralogix. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> <li>Snacks &amp; Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. title: Social Media Senior Manager
description: <p><strong>Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.</p> <p>We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our UK social media strategy and lead social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates. As the most senior Social Media professional in Europe, you'll be the regional lead for the team and the primary social media partner for senior stakeholders.In this role, you'll partner closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media to bring the UK strategy to life—creating platform-specific content, developing cultural relevance, supporting local influencer and ambassador programs, and elevating Wellhub's presence across key platforms like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels.You're someone who lives and breathes social. You understand UK culture deeply. You know how to move fast, test fearlessly, and capture moments in real time. You have a video-first mindset and love being behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera.You'll combine hands-on UK ownership with European team management, stakeholder leadership, and accountability for regional alignment and performance. Your creativity, agility, and understanding of UK social trends will shape how consumers, partners, and companies experience Wellhub.</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>Shape and Execute the UK Social Media Strategy.</li> <li>Shape, localize, and operationalize Wellhub's social media strategy for the UK market.</li> <li>Build regionally relevant content plans tailored for B2C, B2B, and B2P audiences.</li> <li>Support Wellhub's GEO efforts through content strategy, partnering with relevant teams and European social media managers to align content priorities and strengthen brand authority and discoverability across the region.</li> <li>Manage the editorial calendar for the UK and ensure seamless alignment with global priorities, launches, campaigns, and cultural moments.</li> <li>Lead Social Media Managers Across Europe.</li> <li>Manage, coach, and develop social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates, setting clear objectives, supporting professional growth, and enabling local ownership.</li> <li>Set regional priorities with the Senior Director of Global Social Media, align local plans with global strategy, and establish regular planning and performance reviews.</li> <li>Share insights and successful formats across countries, resolve competing priorities, and represent the European social team in global discussions.</li> <li>Create High Impact Video First Content Concept, script, shoot, and edit content optimized for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.</li> <li>Capture spontaneous, social-worthy moments at local events, content shoots, and partner activations.</li> <li>Work with creative and production colleagues to bring fresh ideas to life.</li> <li>Drive Cultural Relevance.</li> <li>Identify UK cultural trends, memes, humor, and moments that Wellhub can authentically participate in.Adapt global narratives to fit the UK social landscape and audience expectations.</li> <li>Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to keep Wellhub culturally and creatively ahead.</li> <li>Lead Local Ambassador and Influencer Execution.</li> <li>Support the development and execution of influencer and ambassador programs in the UK</li> <li>Partner with creators and wellness influencers who authentically represent the Wellhub brand.</li> <li>Manage briefings, content feedback, deliverables, and performance tracking.</li> <li>Lead Stakeholder Relationships Across Europe</li> <li>Act as the most senior Social Media representative in Europe and the primary partner for regional leadership, country leaders, and senior marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner stakeholders.</li> <li>Build alignment on social strategy, priorities, and expectations across European markets.</li> <li>Guide decisions, constructively challenge requests, and resolve escalations while protecting local relevance and global brand consistency.</li> <li>Collaborate with UK marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner teams to amplify locally relevant moments.Work closely with the global creative team to align content quality, storytelling, sonic identity, and brand voice.</li> <li>Support country leaders and internal spokespeople with social content, thought leadership, and engagement guidance.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own Measurement Optimisation and Insights.</li> <li>Track and report on performance metrics across awareness, engagement, growth, and sentiment.Test new formats, creative variations, and posting strategies to continuously improve results.</li> <li>Conduct social listening to understand audience behavior and guide content direction.</li> <li>Review performance across European markets with local social managers and turn shared learnings into regional recommendations and improvements.</li> <li>Community Engagement and Brand Advocacy</li> <li>Oversee proactive community management across the UK channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates.</li> <li>Ensure alignment with global crisis and response protocols.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing—ideally in fast-moving B2C or lifestyle brands.</li> <li>You're fluent in UK social culture, humor, trends, and how different audiences behave online.</li> <li>You have excellent English writing and editorial skills.</li> <li>You're a video-first creator who is comfortable planning, shooting, editing—and occasionally stepping in front of the camera.</li> <li>You're obsessed with social platforms: their algorithms, nuances, and emerging formats.</li> <li>You understand how to speak to diverse audiences—consumers, HR leaders, corporate buyers, wellness partners.</li> <li>You're highly creative, but also organized and able to manage calendars, workflows, approvals, and reporting.</li> <li>You have experience managing and developing social media teams across markets, with the judgement and autonomy to serve as the senior regional lead.</li> <li>You can influence senior stakeholders, explain your recommendations, manage difficult conversations, and align regional priorities with local needs.</li> <li>You excel in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and aren't afraid to test new ideas.</li> <li>You're a collaborative team player who values feedback, teamwork, and cross-functional partnership.</li> <li>You're proactive, curious, and passionate about wellbeing and digital storytelling.</li> </ul> <p>We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.&nbsp;</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></span></h1> <p>With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:</p> <p><strong>WELLHUB:</strong>&nbsp; Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.</p> <p><strong>HEALTHCARE:</strong> Health and dental insurance.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong> </strong><strong>FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: </strong>&nbsp;Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.</p> <p><strong>PAID TIME OFF:</strong> We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>PARENTAL LEAVE:</strong> Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>CAREER GROWTH:</strong> Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,&nbsp; build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>CULTURE:</strong> You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/">Learn more about our shared culture and values here.&nbsp;</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/"><strong>Instagram</strong></a><strong> @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on </strong><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4"><strong>YouTube</strong></a><strong>!</strong></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub</strong></span></h1> <p>We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.&nbsp;</p> <p>Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</p> <p>Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY">Read more about it here.</a></p> <p>Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/">Job Applicant Privacy Notice.</a></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.

We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join Mulberry and play a key role in building the data foundations that will support the next stage of our reporting, analytics and insight capabilities.

Joining as a member of our Data Foundations Project, you’ll help transform how data is brought together, structured and used across the business. You’ll design and build robust data pipelines, models and integration patterns that improve the quality, accessibility and trusted use of data.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll work closely with colleagues across Technology, the wider business and specialist third-party partners. Alongside engineering and delivery, you’ll help shape the technical standards and architecture that underpin our data platform, creating the foundations for reporting, customer insight and future artificial intelligence use cases.

What You’ll Be Doing

Data Platform Architecture

  • Working with the Head of Data, design and document our target data platform architecture in line with the Data Foundations roadmap and wider technology standards.
  • Develop engineering principles, integration patterns, data models and technical standards covering data ingestion, transformation, storage and access.
  • Assess the integration of source systems, platforms and services to create a coherent and scalable data architecture.
  • Identify architectural risks, technical debt and dependencies, recommending practical solutions.

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Design, build, test and maintain robust ETL and ELT pipelines across our core business systems and third-party data sources.
  • Develop and optimise data structures, datasets and transformation processes, primarily within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery.
  • Create reusable integration components and engineering patterns that improve consistency and delivery.
  • Make sure data pipelines are effectively monitored, documented and supported throughout their lifecycle.
  • Investigate and resolve complex data, integration and platform issues, partnering with internal teams and external specialists where needed.

Data Modelling, Quality & Governance

  • Design logical and physical data models that support trusted reporting, analytics and operational use cases.
  • Build a semantic layer to support self-service reporting tools and an MCP layer for natural language interrogation.
  • Implement data quality controls, validation and monitoring to improve the accuracy, completeness and consistency of our data.
  • Enable data lineage, metadata and auditability across priority data domains.
  • Partner with data owners and stakeholders to establish clear definitions, ownership and appropriate access.
  • Ensure solutions support data protection, retention, security and relevant regulatory requirements.

Delivery, Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Turn business and architectural requirements into clear technical designs and practical engineering solutions.
  • Build strong relationships across the business, Technology teams and specialist partners to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance across data engineering and platform delivery, including reviewing third-party designs and code.
  • Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, data flows, mappings, standards and support information.
  • Support knowledge transfer and capability development across our internal Technology teams.
  • Help shape the priorities and ongoing evolution of our data platform roadmap.

About You

You’ll bring significant experience designing and building modern, cloud-based data platforms, combined with strong hands-on engineering capability.

We’re looking for:

  • Significant experience designing and building modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery and associated data services.
  • Proven experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise data pipelines using ETL and ELT techniques.
  • Strong SQL capability and experience working with structured and semi-structured data.
  • Experience in data architecture, data modelling, integration architecture and data warehousing.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise and third-party source systems.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, lineage, metadata and governance requirements within technical solutions.
  • The ability to take incomplete or inconsistent information and turn it into clear technical designs and delivery priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to work independently, lead technical workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs in a changing environment.

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience within retail, consumer, luxury, fashion, ecommerce or omnichannel environments.
  • Experience with dbt or comparable data transformation and orchestration tooling.
  • Experience supporting analytics, machine learning or artificial intelligence use cases.
  • Experience working with ERP, point of sale, product, inventory, pricing, customer, ecommerce or marketing platforms.
  • Experience working with specialist consultancies, implementation partners or managed service providers.
  • A relevant Google Cloud or data engineering certification.

Location

This role is based in our London office, with travel to other Mulberry offices and locations as business needs require.

From time to time, the role may also need to support planned releases or critical data platform issues outside normal working hours.

Culture:

  • Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit.
  • Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues.

Sustainability:

  • Help foster a culture where diversity is celebrated and every individual feels valued, respected, and included. Champion equity, empathy, and understanding in all interactions - internally and externally.

About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We are looking for a Senior Treasury Manager to build and run Finom's treasury function.

Finom safeguards a significant book of customer funds across its regulated entities. Net interest income on that book is a meaningful revenue line, and it will grow. Today the function is up and running: the money is placed, the investment policy is in place, and a large part of the book sits with an external asset manager. What we are building now is the machinery around it — an evidenced limit framework, look-through into what our managers actually hold, automated investment accounting, and a reconciled NII number we can defend to an auditor and a regulator.

That is the job. You will take part in building it, and you will run it while it is being built.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of regulation, liquidity, and commercial impact — not a back-office position. It suits someone who has done this before in a regulated environment and wants to do it again without four layers of committee above them.


What you'll own

Liquidity and funding

  • Daily liquidity positioning and float management across entities and accounts
  • Intraday funding of payment channels; nostro and correspondent account management
  • Collateral and minimum-balance obligations across card schemes, T2, and credit providers
  • Contingency funding — the playbook for the day we need €20m by tomorrow morning
  • A daily treasury balance sheet — net liquidity and net capital available — that reconciles

    • Safeguarding and portfolio

  • Portfolio management of safeguarded client funds: term deposits, MMFs, short-dated debt, held directly and via external managers
  • Safeguarding adequacy: shortfall detection, top-up execution, same-currency discipline
  • Instrument eligibility screening under CRR risk-weight, maturity and WAL constraints, and UCITS/MMF rules
  • Independent, evidenced validation that externally managed allocations sit inside mandate — position-level look-through, daily monitoring of concentration, maturity, WAL and credit quality, breach escalation
  • NII forecasting, attribution, and reconciled performance reporting; treasury inputs into the financial model and company forecast

    • Governance and controls

  • Ownership of the investment policy, limit framework, and eligible-instrument register
  • Treasury governance: decision pack, agenda, decision log, and delegated-authority register
  • Pre-deal checks and post-trade evidencing, designed so that the first line executes and the second line challenges
  • Covenant tracking across credit facilities
  • Regulator, external audit, and second-line engagement on treasury and safeguarding matters

    • Systems and data

  • Selection and implementation of investment accounting and treasury tooling — a Clearwater/Advent-class implementation is already in flight and will be yours
  • Custodian, asset-manager and bank data feeds; API connectivity where it exists and pragmatic alternatives where it doesn't
  • Replacing manual spreadsheet processes with something that survives your holiday

    • Commercial

  • Bank, custodian, broker and asset-manager relationships: onboarding, commercial terms, mandate setting, service review
  • Challenging our managers on allocation, transparency and fees — and changing them if the answers are weak

    • What good looks like in the first 12 months
  • Investment policy and limit framework live, with treasury governance running on a documented decision log
  • Daily, evidenced mandate compliance across the full book — we can answer "are we inside the boundaries?" in minutes, not weeks
  • Investment accounting platform implemented; monthly close on the portfolio no longer manual
  • An NII number that is reconciled, attributed, and forecastable
  • A contingency liquidity playbook that has been tested rather than written

    • Who you are
  • 5+ years in treasury, ALM, fixed income, or portfolio management at a regulated financial institution, EMI/PI, or asset manager
  • Direct experience with client money or safeguarding under PSD2 / EMD — core to this role, not adjacent to it
  • Experience building or materially rebuilding a treasury function, not only operating inside an established one
  • Strong command of bond math, yield and duration, MMF mechanics, and credit and concentration risk at instrument level
  • Track record of automating manual treasury processes and implementing treasury or investment accounting systems
  • Comfortable working with position-level data directly — you can interrogate a portfolio file rather than wait for a report
  • Experience with regulators, external audit, and external asset managers (mandate setting, IMA terms, performance challenge)
  • Sound judgement under time pressure in a lean environment with real accountability and limited cover
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Fluent English
    •  

    Nice to have

  • Familiarity with IFRS 9 or Dutch GAAP (RJ 290) financial instrument accounting
  • SQL or Python
  • Experience in a firm transitioning toward a banking licence
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, copilots) to accelerate analytical and reporting workflows

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.</p> <p>Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You’ll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.</p> <h2><strong>About The Logistics Team</strong></h2> <p>Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.</p> <p>These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.</p> <p>It’s an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team’s work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Be Doing&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>You’ll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.</li> <li>Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.</li> <li>Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.</li> <li>Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.</li> <li>Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.</li> <li>Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h2> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring:</p> <ul> <li>A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.</li> title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection and Response
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.</span><strong> </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.</span></p></div><p>As a founding member of the Security Operations team in EMEA, you will join us at an exciting time in Roblox’s SIRT &amp; SOC program. You will design and build the detections, automation and tooling that let a lean team monitor and protect players, developers, employees and the platform at global scale and serve as security incident commander in the region. This is a highly autonomous role where you will be a primary decision-maker, core to our mission to maintain a highly capable 24/7/365 monitoring and response capability.</p> <p>While you will work in close collaboration with peers at our US West Coast Headquarters, the time difference requires an engineer who can operate independently, making critical decisions without immediate oversight. We favor engineering our way out of toil through automation, orchestration, detections-as-code, and risk-based prioritization,&nbsp;while retaining the deep technical skills required to conduct detailed, hands-on analysis and lead response end-to-end when the situation warrants.</p> <p><strong>Work Environment:</strong> This role is based in London, UK. You will be working from a dedicated, private space located within a shared office environment, designed to enable collaboration while remaining secure.</p> <h2><strong>You will:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build Detection &amp; Response Systems:</strong> Design, write, and maintain production-quality detections, automations and integrations (detections-as-code, SOAR playbooks, data and enrichment pipelines) that scale our monitoring capability and reduce manual toil.</li> <li><strong>Own Tooling &amp; Platform:</strong> Develop and improve the tooling the global SIRT/SOC depends on alert quality and enrichment, case-management integrations and automation that powers reliable "follow-the-sun" hand-offs.</li> <li><strong>Exercise High Autonomy:</strong> Act as the primary Incident Commander for the European time zone, making critical, time-sensitive decisions independently before US HQ comes online. You will serve as the senior-most security engineering point of contact in the region.</li> <li><strong>Drive Strategy &amp; Architecture:</strong> Shape the technical direction of the detection &amp; response engineering function, specifically architecting how global hand-offs and "follow-the-sun" models can be optimized and automated.</li> <li><strong>Command Security Incidents:</strong> Ensure serious threats and impacts are understood, mitigated, and learned from with speed and professionalism, often leading responses end-to-end without immediate escalation paths during local hours — and turning what you learn into durable, automated detections.</li> <li><strong>Conduct Forensic Investigations &amp; Threat Hunt:</strong> Dig into complex context to determine whether threats exist, take decisive action and proactively hunt for anomalous activity in our signals, distinguishing outliers from threats.</li> <li><strong>Lead High-Profile Responses:</strong> Collaborate with Security and Engineering to lead responses to major vulnerabilities or platform-wide events.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate Cross-Functionally:</strong> Work with Legal, HR, Executive teams, and external partners (Developers &amp; Customers). You will also travel semi-regularly to the USA to visit HQ, ensuring deep alignment with central engineering and security leadership.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years across security engineering, Infosec, IT, Infra/SRE, and/or Incident Response.</li> <li><strong>Specialization:</strong> 7+ years specifically in Detection or Response, with a track record of <em>building</em>, writing detections, automation or security tooling, not solely operating.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Proficiency:</strong> Comfortable writing and reviewing production-quality code (Scripting) and building automations, integrations and data pipelines that others depend on.</li> <li><strong>Autonomous Leadership:</strong> Proven ability to work independently in satellite offices or distributed teams. You are comfortable being the "person in charge" during your shift and making calls that impact the business.</li> <li><strong>Incident Command:</strong> Extensive experience operating as an incident commander. You can flex into deep engineering work but also possess the executive presence to coordinate responders and communicate status to leadership.</li> <li><strong>Investigations:</strong> Expert-level capability investigating threats in enterprise and production environments, taking ownership from identification to resolution.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge/Tools/Techniques:</strong> Deep understanding of security tooling (SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, NDR, SOAR) and experience extending or building on it. You are proficient in applying Incident Response frameworks (NIST IR Lifecycle, Cyber Kill Chain, MITRE ATT&amp;CK) to real-world scenarios, and you collaborate effectively with engineering colleagues, leveraging extensive expertise across infrastructure and technologies (Public Cloud, OS, Virtualization, Containerization, Networking, Build/Development infrastructure, and Hardware).</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Builder-Operator:</strong> You would rather automate a problem out of existence than staff around it and you hold yourself to an engineering bar even under incident pressure.</li> <li><strong>A Strategic Self-Starter:</strong> You don't wait for instructions. You identify gaps in coverage — especially those unique to regional or time-zone-specific challenges — and fix them.</li> <li><strong>A Detailed Thinker:</strong> You enjoy exploring the details and considering the second- and third-order effects of your decisions.</li> <li><strong>An Eager Problem Solver:</strong> You are drawn to complex issues rather than avoidant of them.</li> <li><strong>Emboldened to Make Change:</strong> You instinctively ask what you can do to improve the situation rather than waiting to be prompted.</li> <li><strong>Compelled by our Mission:</strong> You are driven by the opportunity to protect our community and the safe space we've created.</li> <li><strong>A Calculated Risk Taker:</strong> You move fast, navigating reasonable risks to take action and build capabilities as quickly as possible.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).</p> <p>Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.</p> <p>For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead, UK, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

 

Working closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other teams across the business, you will identify capability gaps and translate complex operational and technical information into engaging, practical learning experiences. You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

 

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the UK, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion

  • Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams

  • Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge

  • Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments

  • Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively

  • Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance

  • Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes

  • Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively

  • Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification

  • Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities

  • Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities

  • Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Developing and delivering onboarding, technical, safety, and professional-development training

  • Building and maintaining competency frameworks, learning paths, and certification programs

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with operational and technological change

  • Evaluating training effectiveness using participation, performance, and feedback metrics

  • Running train-the-trainer initiatives and supporting local training delivery

  • Continuously iterating on training content, standards, and processes, making improvements based on data and feedback

  • Supporting operational change by creating learning experiences for new tools, vehicles, and systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have a strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation

  • You have demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment

  • You have experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams

  • You have excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible

  • You have experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs

  • You have strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training

  • You possess strong stakeholder-management skills and can collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts

  • You have excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment

  • You are able to work effectively across Europe and travel between operational locations when required

  • You are available to work on-site five days a week

  • You have a clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements

  • You have a safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks

 

Desirable

 

  • Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions

  • Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts

  • Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches

  • Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers

  • Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware

  • Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions

  • Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry

  • Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan

  • Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte   La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout. Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.   Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur : 1. Analyse de documents 2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques 3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation   C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.   Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack  sur Github !   A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :) Les missions 🛠 Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets. Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien. Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production. Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles. Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective. Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire. Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie. Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits. Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour : 🤝  Partager des connaissances  : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,… 🎯  Proposer des évolutions  : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre   Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻  recrutement  : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens. Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. title: RF Systems Engineer
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space. As an RF Systems Engineer, you'll contribute to the design, development, and integration of communication systems across our satellite connectivity and next-generation RF payload programs. You'll work on RF system architecture, signal processing algorithms, and performance analysis, collaborating closely with FPGA , embedded software, systems, and hardware engineers to develop and integrate complex RF technologies. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of RF hardware and signal processing, solving challenging technical problems, and seeing their work go from initial design to in-orbit operation.
